children: Glidelogic Corp. reported third-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, recording revenue of $160038 and net income attributable to stockholders of $35194 versus essentially no revenue and a $23030 loss in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $160,038 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $0 in the prior-year quarter.
Net income attributable to stockholders was $35,194 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus a net loss of $23,030 in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported for the quarter.
Revenue growth in the quarter was driven by a single project-based AI engagement that shifted the company away from near-exclusive reliance on related-party funding.
No recurring revenue stream is yet established; the company is converting project experience into reusable modules through affiliated partners (Streamline, Propaganda GEM) to scale offerings.

Glidelogic is advancing integrated AI services across transformation, finance, content and marketing, with forward-deployed client implementations and a lean operating structure (two executive employees) focused on automation and client engagement.
